Hi Anna — thanks for flagging this.

Short answer: we see the same withholding on our side and it looks like it was applied automatically by a legacy invoicing rule tied to the reseller billing flow for accounts categorized under 'international vendor'. That rule shouldn't have fired for LumenHealth.

Immediate next steps I am initiating:
- I'm asking Finance to issue a unilateral service credit equal to the withheld amount ($12,450) to reverse the ledger entry for Aug.
- Grace (cc'd) will validate whether the credit posts as a contra-invoice or a negative invoice line; that determines how your AP will clear the hold.
- Monica will pull together the VAT/not-withheld evidence we have (tax exemption/withholding release) and a signed company statement that you can share with your team.

I will request a one-time expedited credit and ask Billing to provide a credit memo number by EOD tomorrow. If you prefer a manual refund instead of a credit memo, say so and we'll route to Payments.
